cornerstone.holders: Temasek; JPMAMAPL; CPE River; Ninety One Asia; Alibaba Investment; Huang River; GSAM; Manulife; Taikang Life; China Universal Investors; Bosera International; ICBC Wealth; IvyRock; GBAHIL; Metazone; Verition Fund; GMF and IRMF (Schonfeld; ultimate beneficial owner Schonfeld Strategic Partners Fund LLC)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; frees up on the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Investor names from the cornerstone table on p.266.

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its shareholdings in our Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is 6 months from the Listing Date, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of our securities that it is shown to beneficially own in this prospectus (the “Relevant Shares”)
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07 undertaking: period ending ON the date which is 6 months from the Listing Date; inclusive endpoint, first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the period of a further 6 months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in paragraph (a) above expires, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Relevant Shares if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he will cease to be a controlling shareholder (as defined in the Listing Rules) of our Company.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b)-style undertaking: a further 6 months commencing on expiry of the first period (6 months from the Listing Date); frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
controller_12m.notes: Conditional on ceasing to be a controlling shareholder; effective control maintenance = 12 months from Listing Date.
